description: This script is a smoke test utility for a FastAPI backend. It performs lightweight HTTP checks to verify the backend's reachability, schema availability, CORS configuration, and environment variable presence. It includes functions to get the base URL, validate environment variables, perform CORS preflight checks, and run a sequence of HTTP requests to validate server responses.

methods.name: str _get_base_url()
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL from environment variables BACKEND_BASE_URL or API_BASE_URL, raising an error if neither is set.

methods.name: str _require_env(name: str)
methods.description: Ensures a specific environment variable is set, raising an error if missing.

methods.name: None _maybe_validate_env()
methods.description: Optionally validates presence of SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY environment variables when SMOKE_VALIDATE_ENV=1.

methods.name: None _cors_preflight_check(client: httpx.Client, base_url: str, origin: str)
methods.description: Performs an OPTIONS request to verify CORS configuration on the backend for a specific origin.

methods.name: None run_smoke_test()
methods.description: Main function that runs a sequence of HTTP checks to validate backend health, schema, and CORS setup.

ctags.name: _cors_preflight_check
ctags.pattern: /^def _cors_preflight_check(client: httpx.Client, base_url: str, origin: str) -> None:$/
